settings.eval_cap_source: P2.61 (user approval 2026-11-22): the search without the 2,000 cap; every other setting is E226's filed value (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/predictions.json), as E257 used

expected.reproduction: each item's log line 'polish: 2000 evaluations ... |K| N' gives N equal to E257's capped size_K above (the search is identical up to the old cap). A card other than E257's may flip a decision near the KL bar; a mismatch is reported per item with the size difference, and the item is still read
expected.uncapped_subset: every uncapped |K*| is at most its capped size_K (the polish only removes members) and the search record says capped false
expected.random_reference: p256/sequence_random_s0's uncapped E_b stays near its capped 0.0099 and under every trained seed's
expected.kstar_bar: each polished K* passes E226's bar KL(F || F_K) <= (1 - alpha) KL(F || F_empty), as every E226 search does by construction

rules.reading: E_b per item as rb_states (E257) defines it (commute.stand_in.explained_share over K*'s changed members), from E257's saved num, den, dd and changed arrays (experiments/rb_states/results/large/items_<item>.npz) with the uncapped polished K* (results/large/kstar_<item>.npz, main_in_K_polished)
rules.gap: gap_k = mean uncapped E_b over the seeds of kind k minus the mean over the SFT seeds, for k in rl, rlg (absolute, in E_b's units)
rules.rival_a: both gaps >= 0.01: the cap hid an RL-above-SFT order on E_b
rules.rival_b: both |gap| < 0.01: E_b reads RL and SFT alike without the cap too
rules.otherwise: mixed: reported as read, per kind
rules.no_call: fewer than 2 seeds read for SFT or for a kind: that kind's gap is not called
rules.ties: a gap of exactly 0.01 counts as >= 0.01
